objective: Add one deterministic, read-only, non-blocking exact-head advisory for pull requests targeting main.

rules.statement: The implementation diff changes exactly the seven approved paths and no other path.
The advisory binds contract, approval, base, merge base, policy, target, and evidence to the latest exact head.
Only evaluator code from the exact trusted pull-request base is checked out or executed.
The workflow has explicit minimum read permissions and no write permission or external secret input.
Repeated evaluation of the same bounded metadata emits byte-identical sanitized output.
Pass, block, and needs-human remain non-required report states with no repository or provider mutation.

merge_criteria: The branch remains based on the ratified exact base.
The canonical contract hash and exact head have one new unedited approval comment on issue 1739.
Focused tests, compile validation, exact-file pre-commit, workflow static checks, secret scanning, and exact-head checks pass.
No substantive review thread remains unresolved.
A separate explicit maintainer merge decision is recorded and auto-merge remains disabled.
stop_conditions: Any file outside the seven-path allowlist is required.
Any dependency, write permission, secret, PR-head execution, unpinned action, or raw patch, log, transcript, or artifact ingestion is required.
Any ruleset, branch-protection, bypass, auto-merge, provider, deployment, database, staging, IPv6, Supabase, Vercel, Sentry, Grafana, or observability change is required.
The result cannot remain deterministic, bounded, sanitized, latest-head-only, and non-blocking.
